# Generated English site content

**Do not edit these files by hand.**

Sources of truth:

| Site file | Edit instead |
|-----------|--------------|
| `guide.md` | `docs/GIT_FROM_ZERO.md` |
| `labs/<id>.md` | `labs/<id>/README.md` |

Refresh copies:

```bash
npm run sync:en
```

CI fails if this tree drifts from the sources. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../CONTRIBUTING.md).
